title: Security Considerations: receiveTypingIndicators reference lacks section anchor
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md, the Security Considerations / Blocked Contacts subsection mentions receiveTypingIndicators without a cross-reference to its normative definition. A security reviewer who reads that section directly cannot easily locate the Chat object field definition or Chat/typing behavior. Adding a section cross-reference would help navigability.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
